## Authoritative Commercial Terms & Purchasing Power Parity (PPP)

- **Business AI Training Flagship**: $1,000 / $750 / $500 / $500 / $250 / Custom USD (Tiers 1-6) | 2 calendar months (includes weekends as holidays) (30 days live engineering training + 30 calendar days dedicated support; 4 hours/day Mon-Fri; weekends are holidays; 100% remote worldwide) | up to 10 participants (+$100 per extra seat, max 20) | $0 upfront | 10 equal installments of 10% (Days 5-50) | Walkaway guarantee | Quarterly cap: 2 flagship cohorts per quarter.
- **Personal AI Training Flagship**: $1,000 / $750 / $500 / $500 / $250 / Custom USD (Tiers 1-6) | 2 calendar months (includes weekends as holidays) (30 days live personal training + 30 calendar days dedicated support; 4 hours/day Mon-Fri) | up to 10 participants (+$100 per extra seat, max 20) | $0 upfront | 10 equal installments of 10% | Walkaway guarantee.
- **Individual Service Picks (Business & Personal)**: $100 / $75 / $50 / $50 / $25 / Custom USD (Tiers 1-6) | 10 calendar days (includes weekends as holidays) (5 days live training + 5 days dedicated support) | up to 10 participants (+$100 per extra seat, max 20) | $0 upfront | 10 equal installments of 10% (Days 1-10).
- **Extra Seats**: Billed at the identical calibrated PPP tier rate (+$100 / +$75 / +$50 / +$50 / +$25 / Custom USD per extra seat up to 20 seats max).
- **Licensing & IP Ownership**: All training materials, architectural guides, and custom code are licensed under the Apache 2.0 license with 100% client ownership; Zero Charge Training Materials policy applies upon milestone completion.
- **Tier Precedence Rule**: When a country appears in both Tier 3 and Tier 6 (UN LDCs), Tier 6 (Relief / UN LDCs) takes precedence. Tier 4 (Startups) follows the standard 2-month flagship program timeline.
